_comment: Detector artefacts used by the proctoring worker. Every artefact that is present is verified against its SHA-256 digest before use, so a substituted or corrupted model cannot become examination evidence. Required artefacts (face-cascade) are fatal when missing; optional artefacts (DNN weights, landmark model) log a warning and are skipped — the engine degrades gracefully without crashing.

models.name: opencv-haarcascade-frontalface
models.note: Bundled with the OpenCV package. Required for engine operation — engine refuses to start if this file is missing or corrupted.

models.name: yunet-face-weights
models.note: YuNet ONNX face detector. Detects small and partially occluded faces far more reliably than the res10 SSD at webcam resolution. If absent, the engine falls back to the bundled Haar cascade.

models.name: yolox-s-object-weights
models.note: YOLOX-S ONNX detector trained on COCO. Uses the contiguous COCO index: 67 = cell phone, 73 = book. If absent, object detection is unavailable but face detection continues.

models.name: lbf-facial-landmarks
models.note: 68-point LBF facial landmark model used for head pose estimation. If absent, head pose is reported as unavailable rather than inferred from unrelated measurements.

deployment_checklist: 1. Run scripts/download-vision-models.sh --dest /etc/examos/models to download every artefact and verify its SHA-256 digest.
2. Alternatively, download each model file from its listed source URL and compute SHA-256 manually.
3. The digests in this manifest are the approved digests; replace one only together with a reviewed model rotation.
4. Place model files in the same directory as this manifest (/etc/examos/proctor/models/ on the kiosk image).
5. Set EXAMOS_PROCTOR_DETECTOR_CONFIG to point to this manifest file.
6. On first proctoring start, the vision engine will verify all digests before loading. Any mismatch is a fatal error for required artefacts and disables the optional capability otherwise.
7. Only haarcascade_frontalface_default.xml ships in the base OS image. All DNN weights must be provisioned per-deployment.
